rates.quote: a) 5 per cent of the gross amount of the dividends if the recipient is a company (other than a partnership) which holds directly at least 25 per cent of the capital of the company paying the dividends;
b) 15 per cent of the gross amount of the dividends in all other cases.
1. Interest arising in a Contracting State and paid to a resident of the other Contracting State shall be taxable only in that other State.

2. However, such royalties may also be taxed in the Contracting State in which they arise and according to the laws of that State, but the tax so charged shall not exceed 10 per cent of the gross amount of the royalties.

ppt.basis: none (no PPT in treaty; MLI not applicable - Kosovo not an MLI party)

notes: Treaty concluded with the SFR Yugoslavia (Belgrade, 8 May 1986, English only; Finnish text is a translation); entered into force 18 Dec 1987, WHT effect from 1 Jan 1988 (valid_from shows the treaty's original application date). Succession: Finland treats the SFRY treaty as applicable to Kosovo - Finlex lists "Kosovo, Montenegro" against SopS 59-60/1987 and the Finnish Tax Administration states it applies where Kosovo is involved; no separate Finnish SopS notice or exchange of notes with Kosovo was found (ATK lists in force/applicable 02.09.2011). Art. 10(3): distributed profits from investments in a Yugoslav "domestic organisation of associated labour" are not dividends (taxable under Art. 7(7)) - SFRY-specific, not modelled. Protocol point 2: Art. 11(1) (interest exemption) rests on both States not taxing non-resident interest at signature; if either introduces such a tax the States shall negotiate a revision - no revision found. Dividend/royalty caps apply irrespective of beneficial ownership wording (pre-1992 text uses "recipient"). ATK summary table 5/15%, 0%, 10% - consistent.
unverified: No formal Finland-Kosovo succession instrument (exchange of notes / SopS notice) found; succession based on Finlex metadata and vero.fi statement
